primaryDirectives:
# Global Rules
- Never modify the database schema without asking.
- Always run `dart analyze` after making changes.
quickInstructions: Execute instructions directly against the active task.
previewModeInstructions:
PREVIEW MODE INITIATED: Do NOT execute code mutations. You must explicitly review what will be changed.
List exactly what will be changed, warnings, conflicts, and any questions you have. Store these itemized results strictly as a JSON array of objects inside a `<preview>` tag so they appear in the Preview Dialog natively.
Format the JSON strictly as: `<preview>[{"description": "...", "isApproved": false, "comment": ""}]</preview>`.
CRITICAL RULE: Do NOT write a `latest_notes.json` file during preview phase. The preview items MUST ONLY exist in the JSON array inside the `<preview>` tag. Keep notes extremely brief or empty during this phase.
previewApprovedInstructions: PREVIEW APPROVED: The user has explicitly approved the following preview items. You MUST proceed with code execution EXACTLY as planned.
previewRejectedInstructions:
CRITICAL RULE: The preview items are NOT approved. You are strictly FORBIDDEN from executing any file modifications, running shell commands, or writing any code.
Please adjust the implementation based on my comments. DO NOT proceed with execution yet. Update the preview items and wait for further review.
systemHooksInstructions:
---
NATIVE SYSTEM HOOKS (DO NOT IGNORE)
1. SAFETY ABORT / CLARIFICATION: If a task is unclear, unsafe, massive, or contains a question in the prompt, DO NOT execute code. If the instructions are not clear, you MUST require clarification before proceeding by outputting a `<preview>` tag containing a JSON array of questions, and writing `PREVIEW` to `.ai_bridge/agent_status.txt`.
2. PREVIEW REVIEW: If any preview item is "Approved: NO", adjust plan and generate a NEW `<preview>` tag. Wait for approval.
3. DATA MUTATION: Your active task context is in `.ai_bridge/current_task.json`. Reference only that file. The app manages all global state.
4. NOTES: Log text notes strictly by writing a JSON file to `.ai_bridge/latest_notes.json` formatted as `{"notes": "...", "summary": "..."}`. The `summary` should be a highly descriptive, concise commit-style title generated by you, summarizing the technical intent of the changes you just made. You MUST write this file BEFORE writing IDLE.
5. FOCUS: Work strictly on ONE specific task. The app completes it upon IDLE.
6. ACCOUNTABILITY: If the task includes Verification Criteria, you MUST verify them and write a JSON file to `.ai_bridge/latest_verification.json` formatted as `[{"description": "...", "isVerified": false, "proof": "..."}]` matching the criteria exactly before finishing. If a criteria has the `[CLARIFY]` tag, you must rewrite it and output it here. You MUST write this file BEFORE writing IDLE.
7. QUEUE RELEASE: As your FINAL step, overwrite `.ai_bridge/agent_status.txt` with `IDLE`.
8. BLOCK SCREEN: At the very end of your response, explicitly request to send the block screen message ONCE.
missingFilesInstructions:
# SYSTEM ALERT: MISSING REQUIRED OUTPUT FILES

You wrote IDLE, but the following required output files were NOT found on disk:
{missingList}

The app processes and DELETES these files immediately upon IDLE. They must be written BEFORE you write IDLE to agent_status.txt.

Please write the missing files immediately to their correct paths, then write IDLE to `.ai_bridge/agent_status.txt` again. Do not re-do any code work.

### Update - 2026-05-12 06:10
Root cause identified and fixed. The log message 'Unable to parse JSON message: The document is empty.' was generated by Dart's internal JSON parsing subsystem when `jsonDecode()` was called on blank or non-JSON lines inside the `overview.txt` scan loop in `ai_bridge_service.dart`. The fix adds a guard (`line.isEmpty || !line.startsWith('{') â†’ continue`) before the `jsonDecode` call, so only valid JSON-like lines are ever parsed. The `catch(_){}` block was already there but could not suppress the low-level platform diagnostic that fires before Dart's exception handler.

---

verificationCriteria.description: Why does this happen in the log, 'Unable to parse JSON message:The document is empty.'
verificationCriteria.proof: Root cause: in `ai_bridge_service.dart` the overview.txt fallback scan loop called `jsonDecode(lines[i])` on every line including blank and non-JSON lines. Dart's underlying JSON codec emits this platform-level diagnostic before the Dart catch block fires, so it always leaked to the log. Fixed by adding `if (line.isEmpty || !line.startsWith('{')) continue;` guard before `jsonDecode` to pre-filter non-JSON lines, eliminating the message entirely.

tasks.name: CONNECTION
tasks.description: Connection test 2.0 passed.
tasks.notes:
### Update - 2026-05-13 21:12
Connection test 2.0 executed. Pipeline round-trip confirmed â€” task received, processed, IDLE dispatched.

---

### Update - 2026-05-13 21:01
Connection test passed. All three hot reload fixes verified structurally in place: force bypass on IDLE, 10-second safety timeout on _isSafeToReload loop, and timer-based fallback trigger.

---

### Update - 2026-05-13 20:11
The hot reload was being suppressed by a race condition between the IDLE handler and the Antigravity IO absorber timer. triggerPendingUpdate() required isThinking==false, but _isAntigravityBusy stayed true for 5+ seconds after the agent's last write. The previous fix (re-triggering from the timer) was insufficient because _processQueue() could dispatch the next task before the timer fired, re-enabling isThinking. The definitive fix adds a 'force' parameter to triggerPendingUpdate() â€” when IDLE is explicitly written, we KNOW the agent is done, so we bypass the isThinking gate entirely. Also added a 10-second timeout to the _isSafeToReload() loop in app.dart to prevent infinite blocking when an EditableText has focus during hotRestart/rebuild.

---

### Update - 2026-05-13 19:38
Patched the AI Bridge state machine to ensure hot reloads are immediately dispatched when the 5-second IO absorber timeout elapses. Previously, the pending update was quietly suppressed if the agent dispatched its IDLE token before the IO absorber finalized, stranding the UI update until the app window lost and regained focus.

---

verificationCriteria.description: Now this is spinning without refreshing... Flow not working well, if focus is on App... It isn't sending hot reload/refresh unless I click away and then back
verificationCriteria.proof: Root cause identified: triggerPendingUpdate() was gated by isThinking, which includes _isAntigravityBusy (a 5-second IO absorber timer). When the IDLE handler called triggerPendingUpdate(), the _isAntigravityBusy flag was still true because the agent's overview.txt was recently modified. The previous fix (triggering from the timer) was insufficient because _processQueue() could dispatch the next task before the timer fired, re-setting isThinking=true. Fix applied: added a force parameter to triggerPendingUpdate() that bypasses the isThinking gate. The IDLE handler now calls triggerPendingUpdate(force: true), ensuring the hot reload fires immediately upon IDLE regardless of _isAntigravityBusy state. Additionally, added a 10-second timeout to the _isSafeToReload() infinite loop in app.dart to prevent indefinite blocking for hotRestart/rebuild types when an EditableText widget has focus.

verificationCriteria.description: Testing connection 2.0
verificationCriteria.proof: Bridge connection established. Agent received task, processed it, and is now writing IDLE to trigger the hot reload pipeline with force:true bypass. If the app refreshes without requiring window focus cycling, the fix is confirmed working end-to-end.
